about: Prefill (prompt tokens a second, the server's timings) of one request of `prompt` tokens, max_tokens 1, --spec none --no-prefix-reuse, master 03afc418 (2026-10-28, choice-notes/lab/speed_model; the Q8_0 and Gemma 4 12B rows master f8d4399d, 2026-10-30, after PR #249); Qwen3.5-9B's Q6_K, Q5_K_M and Q4_K_S rows by mpref.sh on master f8d4399d (2026-10-31, the median of three, 7K and 22K prompts), as are Gemma 4 12B's Q5_K_M and Q6_K rows (the RTX 2080 Ti's 22K Q6_K did not run); prompts of 3K tokens and more (below, a request's fixed time the model leaves out dominates). A quantization's role_formats: its GGUF's trunk linears' formats by role (plan_facts.cpp gguf_role), shares of the role's elements (scratchpad grole.py, 2026-10-31); the models' linear_roles name each linear's.
